why: Tests step for the mock sweep's app-e2e slice, ticket 1067 (0555, 0579), in next/ and our tooling, plan docs/plan/quests/mock-app-e2e-PLAN.md at 14e9b3134, branch fabrikalfa/mock-app-e2e-s1. Upstream Effect has no warn reader: main's packages/effect/src/testing/TestConsole.ts and the 4.1.4 release have only logLines and errorLines, and no Effect-TS/effect issue or pull request names warnLines. So pnpm patch added TestConsole.warnLines to patches/effect@4.1.3.patch in src, dist and the .d.ts, in errorLines' shape, and pnpm-workspace.yaml's comment names it; the upstream issue is the lead's to file. L1 (next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/build/bundle-warnings.test.ts) is red now: one Console.warn line per kept warning: expected [] to have a length of 3 but got +0, since bundle still prints through Rolldown's handler and the global console. L2 (L17 in next/apps/fabrika/e2e/reload.visual.test.ts) ran here, the 0178 guard allowed it on this Linux box: red, the unresolved import warning is still printed: expected false to be true, for the same reason. L3 (scripts/effect-testconsole.test.ts) and L4 (VI_METHODS in oxlint-plugins/builtin-plants.ts, scenario in plants.test.ts) are green. L5 is not done: oxlint's vitest/no-restricted-vi-methods misses a call chained onto the vi call, so the old spy put back passes pnpm lint. To run L1's and L2's plants, a stand-in onLog printing through Console was put in bundle.ts, L1 and L2 were seen green on it, each plant ran on it, and bundle.ts was restored by copy before the commit.
note: Plan and code differ in two places, code wins. L1 is a plain .test.ts, not .integration.: lint:kind (oxlint-plugins/test-kind.ts) says it reaches no real thing, since its files come from a plugin. The lock block's messages are node's plan's five, word for word, so a later fold merges the two blocks as a union of files. Plan gaps: Rolldown already writes these messages relative to cwd, so the plan's first plant (print log.message before the replacement) stays green on L17 and on L1's first draft; L1 now has a plugin warn from transform with the module's absolute id, which only bundle's replacement makes relative. And vitest/no-restricted-vi-methods misses vi.spyOn(...).mockImplementation(...) and vi.fn().mockReturnValue(...) in oxlint 1.90.0 and 1.93.0 alike, though the same call in parentheses is refused; VI_METHODS lists the miss as REFLECT lists its alias miss.
